components.name: View chip (off / on)
components.description: Labelled toggle for Focused or Simplified view; teal when on.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;gap:8px}.ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;padding:0 12px;font:600 0.85rem/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;color:#5e574c;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbc3b6;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),color .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-chip svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.9}.ds-chip:hover{background:#f2eee7;color:#1f4e4d}.ds-chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:#2f6f6e;border-color:#2f6f6e;color:#fff}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1b4d4c;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Footer actions (Fullscreen, Help, About, Ko-fi); teal-filled when a toggle is on.

components.name: Reset (labelled action)
components.description: The one labelled action in the footer row.

components.name: Panel show button
components.description: Screen-corner button that brings the hidden side panel back.

components.name: Chosen-feelings list
components.description: Read-only family stem with stepped depth and a definition under the chosen word.
components.html:
Happy

Playful

Light, spontaneous, and ready to have fun without taking things too seriously.

To remove one, choose it again on the wheel.
components.css: .ds-family{position:relative;padding-left:16px;font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;color:#2b2a28}.ds-family::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:3px;border-radius:2px;background:#FFFF99}.ds-f{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.2}.ds-core{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700}.ds-sec{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;padding-left:16px}.ds-f i{width:.42em;height:.42em;border-right:2px solid #736b5e;border-bottom:2px solid #736b5e;transform:rotate(-45deg)}.ds-f i.ds-open{transform:rotate(45deg);margin-top:-.3em}.ds-def{margin:0 0 0 32px;max-width:42ch;font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.45;color:#5e574c}.ds-hint{margin:12px 0 0;font:400 .8rem/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;color:#736b5e}

components.name: View status line
components.description: Says which view is on in words, with a way back.
components.html: Simplified view: outer ring hidden, simpler meanings. Still chosen but hidden: Cheeky.
components.css: .ds-status{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:4px 12px;padding:12px 24px;background:#f2eee7;border-bottom:1px solid #e4ded4;font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-status p{flex:1 1 14rem;margin:0;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.4;color:#5e574c}.ds-status button{padding:4px 0;font:600 .875rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;color:#1f4e4d;background:none;border:none;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em;cursor:pointer}.ds-status button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #1b4d4c;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Reading lens
components.description: Large copy of the pressed or focused wheel word with its family path.
components.html: Happy › PlayfulCheeky← → move · ↓ ↑ change ring · Enter chooses
components.css: .ds-lens{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:8px 24px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4ded4;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(43,42,40,.08),0 2px 4px rgba(43,42,40,.06);font-family:'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;text-align:center}.ds-path{font-size:.85rem;color:#5e574c}.ds-word{font-size:1.75rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:#2b2a28}.ds-keys{margin-top:4px;font-size:.75rem;color:#5e574c}

components.name: Wheel tip
components.description: Transient one-line pill pinned to the wheel's edge (small-screen tip, Focused hint).
components.html: Hold one to read it.

narrative.overview:
The wheel is a calm, faithful map that a therapist and client read together. The interface's job is to make the map easy to share and then step back. It never interprets, never decorates, and never competes with the words. Everything around the wheel is warm paper, charcoal ink and one quiet teal. Colour lives in the wheel, because the wheel's family colours are part of the established tool, not the brand.

The system is low-arousal on purpose. Clients may be distressed, so surfaces are soft and warm rather than stark, motion is a gentle ease rather than a flourish, and nothing flashes, bounces or demands attention. Density is set by the content: the full 130-word wheel is the default, so the chrome around it is sparse and pushed to the edges. That means a side panel on wide screens, a bottom sheet on phones, and corner controls that a circle can never reach.

Legibility comes first. Atkinson Hyperlegible is used everywhere, text pairs are contrast-audited to WCAG AA, and small words get a reading lens rather than being dropped.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and charcoal ink, never pure black on white.
One accent (calm teal), used for state and focus, never for decoration.
The wheel's family colours belong to the wheel alone.
Chrome sits at the edges; the wheel always gets the centre and the space.
Soft, slow-ish motion (0.15–0.35s, one easing curve), and none when reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: The Map-Holds-the-Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour belongs to the wheel's families. UI chrome uses paper, ink and teal only. Never tint a control with a family colour or theme a screen around one.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Calm Teal marks state (on, pressed, selected, focused). If something is teal, it is on or it has focus.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Atkinson Hyperlegible everywhere: chrome, list and wheel. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and indent, never a second family.

rules.name: The Fit-Never-Overflows Rule
rules.body: A wheel word may shrink to fit its wedge, but it never spills over a boundary. When it gets small, offer the reading lens instead of cutting words.

rules.name: The Circle-Owns-the-Centre Rule
rules.body: Nothing may sit over the wheel's disc except a transient, pointer-transparent overlay (lens, hint, tip). Persistent controls live in the panel or in a corner.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use warm charcoal at 12% opacity or less. If a shadow is noticeable before the thing it lifts, it's too strong.

dos: **Do** keep chrome in paper, ink and Calm Teal (#2f6f6e). Teal means "on" or "focused".
**Do** give the wheel the centre and the space. Put persistent controls in the panel or a corner.
**Do** use Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything, with hierarchy from size (1.5 / 1.25 / 1.05 / 0.95 / 0.85rem) and weight (400 / 600 / 700).
**Do** use warm, low-alpha shadows (Rest / Lifted / Sheet) and the single easing curve `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` at 0.15–0.35s.
**Do** keep every text pair at WCAG AA or better, every control boundary at 3:1 or better, and touch targets at 44px or larger.
**Do** shrink a wheel word to fit its wedge, and offer the reading lens when it gets small.
donts: **Don't** use the wheel's family colours for UI chrome, or add new saturated colours.
**Don't** put persistent controls over the wheel's disc. The old mid-edge panel tab covered outer-ring words.
**Don't** use pure black text, pure white backgrounds behind the wheel, or cold grey shadows.
**Don't** add bouncy or elastic easing, looping animation, or motion that ignores reduced-motion settings.
**Don't** add visual "insight" devices (scores, charts, mood colours, badges) around chosen feelings. The list stays a plain, read-only record.
